verdict.rationale: Some components in the Visa Intelligent Commerce ecosystem are open — the Trusted Agent Protocol repo is explicitly confirmed to ship a reference implementation 'under an open license' with a public README, and the Agent Toolkit is published on GitHub/npm — but the core Intelligent Commerce platform (tokenization, mandates, instruction/authorization APIs) remains a closed, proprietary API service with no source access. Missing for 10: no open-license source for the core payment/authorization platform itself, no explicit license identifier cited for the agent-toolkit repo, and no independent confirmation of license terms beyond the TAP probe.
